Action.label: Staleness check — Tasker-fresh/Termux-stale >1h, both >24h, or a no_root streak echoes STALE
Action.Str: H=/sdcard/Tasker/mvwifi_history.log; N=/sdcard/mvwifi_nudge.log; W=/sdcard/Tasker/mvwifi_watchdog.log; NOW=$(date +%s); HAGE=$(( NOW - $(stat -c %Y $H 2>/dev/null || echo 0) )); NAGE=$(( NOW - $(stat -c %Y $N 2>/dev/null || echo 0) )); DETAIL=; if [ $HAGE -lt 3600 ] && [ $NAGE -gt 3600 ]; then DETAIL=termux-silent; fi; if [ $HAGE -gt 86400 ]; then DETAIL="$DETAIL tasker-silent"; fi; if [ $(tail -20 $N 2>/dev/null | grep -c no_root) -ge 3 ]; then DETAIL="$DETAIL no_root-streak"; fi; if [ -n "$DETAIL" ]; then echo "$NOW | watchdog | stale:$DETAIL" >> $W; echo STALE; fi

Action.label: Alert only when something has gone quiet

Action.Str: Stale activity detected — details in 'watchdog | stale' lines of /sdcard/Tasker/mvwifi_watchdog.log (termux-silent = dead Termux; tasker-silent = project gone; no_root-streak = root broken)
